text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 3, 2024) for 88 Bloor Street East.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 3, 2024) for 88 Bloor Street East, Folder Number 24 206086 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to October 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
